notes.title: Regarding the connection cable.
notes.content: "Kwaidan" is set to play at 30fps to reproduce retro graphics, but it has been reported that fps may drop when connected to a monitor using Displayport (144HZ). In that case, change to another connection cable such as HDMI.

notes.title: About operation by "Keyboard & Mouse".
notes.content:
If you want to play Kwaidan by "Keyboard & Mouse" operation, please remove the gamepad from your PC !
(* If the gamepad is still connected to the PC, the mouse will not function properly.)
